fileEvent-type.label: Type
fileEvent-type.tip: Certain specific behaviors automatically trigger related type events

fileEvent-priority.label: Priority
fileEvent-priority.tip: Triggers before element events; not affected by "Pause Game" and "Prevent Scene Input" commands

fileEvent-namespace.label: Namespace
fileEvent-namespace.tip:
Enable: event uses independent variable scope when called
Disable: event shares variable scope with caller

fileEvent-returnType.label: Return Type
fileEvent-returnType.tip: Pass computed result to caller via "Return"

fileEvent-description.label: Description
fileEvent-description.tip: Remarks or description of the event

fileEvent-parameters.label: Parameters
fileEvent-parameters.tip:
Parameter values can be passed when calling this event via "Call Event"
Parameters are automatically written to these variables during execution

fileEvent-parameter-type.label: Type
fileEvent-parameter-type.tip: Type of value received when called

boolean.name: Boolean
boolean.tip: Pass a boolean value to the initial variable
